rule_name: WPCrack -> Privilege Escalation -> (Root Access / DNS Exfiltration)

tree.name: Phát hiện WPCrack
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WHERE http.is_scanner = true OR http.uri CONTAINS 'wp-login.php' OR http.is_suspicious_payload = true WITH ip, count(req) AS wp_count, min(datetime(req.last_seen)) AS time_wpcrack WHERE wp_count >= 10 RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, wp_count, toString(time_wpcrack) AS time_wpcrack ORDER BY time_wpcrack ASC

on_match.alert_message: ⚠️ [LOW] Phát hiện IP {attacker_ip} thực hiện dò quét Wordpress ({wp_count} requests) lúc {time_wpcrack}

next.name: Chuyển tài khoản trái phép bằng su
next.query: MATCH (u:User)-[su:RAN_AS]->(p:Process) WHERE (su.is_su = true OR su.is_sudo = true OR su.target_user = 'root') AND datetime(su.last_seen) >= datetime($time_wpcrack) - duration('PT1H') WITH u, su.target_user AS target_user, max(datetime(su.last_seen)) AS time_su RETURN u.username AS original_user, target_user AS compromised_user, toString(time_su) AS time_su

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [MEDIUM] Tài khoản Web {original_user} đã leo quyền thành {compromised_user} lúc {time_su}!

next.name: Lạm dụng Sudo
next.query: MATCH (u:User {username: $compromised_user})-[exec:EXECUTED]->(p:Process) WHERE p.is_sudo = true OR p.exe CONTAINS 'sudo' OR p.command STARTS WITH 'sudo' WITH u, p.command AS root_command, max(datetime(exec.last_seen)) AS time_sudo WHERE datetime(time_sudo) >= datetime($time_su) RETURN root_command, toString(time_sudo) AS time_sudo LIMIT 3

next.name: Tuồn dữ liệu qua DNS
next.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[q:QUERIED]->(dns:DNSQuery) WHERE (dns.is_exfiltration = true OR size(dns.rrname) > 50) AND datetime(q.last_seen) >= datetime($time_su) WITH ip, count(q) AS dns_count, min(datetime(q.last_seen)) AS time_dns, max(datetime(q.last_seen)) AS last_time WHERE dns_count > 50 RETURN ip.ip AS exfil_ip, dns_count, toString(last_time) AS time_dns

on_match.alert_message: 💥 [HIGH] Máy chủ {exfil_ip} đang gửi {dns_count} gói dữ liệu qua DNS Tunneling lúc {time_dns}!
